releaseNotes:
Release v0.17.0

New Features:
- Provide Dictionary: Output Key-Value List toggle

Bug Fixes:
- Send Email: correct TLS handling - STARTTLS on 587-style ports, implicit TLS on 465, true plaintext option with warning (PS-230)
- Send Email: attachments are now actually attached instead of a placeholder string (PS-227)
- Display parameters (node log / node image) no longer lose runtime updates in subgraphs, loops, and when switching tabs (PS-204)
- File System Operations: directory-copy target handling, empty-input behavior, and a guard against moving a folder into itself (PS-199, PS-200)
- Webhook rate limiter replenished 1 request per 200s instead of 200 requests/s (PS-210)

Improvements:
- Triggers and the UI no longer go silent after event bursts (broadcast channel lag recovery, all trigger types)
- Dependency refresh (consolidated dependabot round; mail-send now uses the platform TLS trust store)

Also new since 0.15 (from 0.16.0, which was not distributed via the updater):
- Provide Dictionary and Provide List nodes, for authoring structured values inline without a JSON Parser node (PS-221)
- Multiline text parameters open in a full editor tab (PS-220)
- List and dictionary entries written as JSON are emitted as that type; values arriving from a data connection keep the types their source gave them
